title: Causal Step math-first comparison contract v0.3 — preserve source physical category, scrutinize fine-grained explanatory framing
status: PROPOSED RESEARCH METHOD CLARIFICATION; human-originated nuanced use of physical interpretation with math-first structural discovery. Not an IsoGraph Core/qualified semantics change.

extends.compatibility: All original-source mathematics, required assumptions, structural-match criteria and negative controls from v0.2 retained. v0.3 corrects only the overly strong rejection of authors' physical labels. All historical records remain historical and source-citation/provenance intact.

underlyingSourceExtractionContract.compatibility: all earlier source contract obligations remain. Existing source records retained as historical; future extractions add this view without silently treating the paper's author-proposed ontology as source-native primitives.

controllingDirections.record: 2026-10-14 researcher message correcting 'generated propagation versus fixed-order propagation' distinction
controllingDirections.requirement: do not use original theory's fixed/dynamic characterization as relevance gate. Mathematical operations on a fixed domain, kernels, recursive compositional identities, observers and explicit rewrites are all eligible, provided precise mathematical domain and lawful operations are stated.

extract source mathematics and induced relationships, allowed operations and implications independently of the author's explanatory physical narrative or terminology; string field/algebra, worldsheet gluing and any other theory may be studied without importing its ontology into primitive Causal Step.
never use numerical physical measurements, assumed units, fitted astronomical phenomena, dimension guesses or scalar closeness as foundational matching criteria.

controllingDirections.record: 2026-10-14 researcher clarification on broad physical labels, fine-grained interpretative biases and eight-dimensional formulation example
controllingDirections.requirement: Retain source authors' BROAD phenomenon identification as potentially correct and useful as a post-match interpretive clue; do not let their finer unverified explanatory/ontological picture constrain the mathematical relational abstraction. Preserve exact source constraints and all mathematically established details. Do not force source dimension/coordinate/physical explanation onto Causal Step; treat original author's label as contextual evidence only with independently specified support.

A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.mathematicalObjects: source-native sets, categories, operator/state spaces, grades, symmetry actions, typing and domains as written in original source
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.prerequisites: all LOAD-BEARING mathematical assumptions, ambient structures, algebra axioms, metric/Hilbert/geometry/field only if mathematically required by the theorem
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.operations: total/partial maps, multilinear products, guard predicates, kernels, derivations, boundary/sewing, contraction, rewriting, operators, exact invariants, limits, projections
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.lawfulness: well-typed expressions; equations and identities under their stated quantifiers, side conditions, and equivalences
A_sourceDefinedMathematicalKernel.sourceVersion: verifiable original paper exact page/section/formula; do not silently transfer page numbering or interpretation across editions

B_authorInterpretationSeparate.claims: Author physical interpretations must be split into (i) BROAD intended physical phenomenon/domain and (ii) NARROW mechanistic/ontological explanations. Retain both for provenance, but apply different evidential treatment. Broad physical categorization may be meaningful interpretive context after a mathematical correspondence is found. Narrow explanations are defeasible and must not restrict mathematical extraction or equivalence search.
B_authorInterpretationSeparate.warnings: A label (gravity, photon, string, field, neutrino, Higgs, dimension, entropy) is neither a proof nor a reason to reject a mathematical match. A category can have independent empirical/mathematical warrant; a local picture can be speculative, conditional, or rigorously derived, and must be checked claim by claim rather than dismissed by its specificity.
B_authorInterpretationSeparate.provenance: Record original authors' general phenomenon categories and exact theorem claims alongside their narrower interpretive statements, with their independent evidence and uncertainty; separately credit Joshua Oshiro's method and agent extraction.

C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.symbolMap: explicitly defined and typed source symbols to a project-neutral relational/operator language; renamings allowed when mathematically well-formed
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.candidateRoles: relations and incidence; n-ary interaction; operator on given relations; composition, graded derivation, context, update, identity, gluing, recursion, obstruction and history dependence
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.sourcePreservation: audit every source law/guard/side condition/quantifier retained or dropped in the abstraction
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.noForcedReinterpretation: do not force a fixed-graph functional into a rewrite or call a string-field product a Causal Step event merely because arity resembles a hyperedge
C_formulationIndependentStructuralAbstra.noEarlyExclusion: no original-discipline domain, fixed-input operator, higher-level science or fundamental theory is categorically disfavored as MATH; tentative generative-depth hypothesis can guide scheduling of PHYSICAL hypotheses but cannot veto a mathematical match

D_scopedComparisons.scopeAndEquivalence: name exact subset, sign/grade conventions, admissible operation set, renaming equivalence, what reversibility/reconstruction is required, source and target assumptions
D_scopedComparisons.forward: for selected operations f, compare F(f_source(inputs)) to f_target(F(inputs)) and state when defined
D_scopedComparisons.backward: prove reconstruction/equivalence only for the claimed level; do not infer full process bisimulation from an n-ary algebraic shape or static observer
D_scopedComparisons.negativeCases: record nonmaps, information loss, hidden source premises, failed event identity and third-event history/coherence; retain T4 83 state-indexed independence and 660 triple-composition obstructions
D_scopedComparisons.uncertainty: candidate mathematical shared shape != proved isomorphism != common physical substrate

researchExecution: Read and preserve exact source equations, typed structures, logical/operational side conditions, proofs and assumption boundaries, regardless of author's physical frame.
Preserve source's broad intended physical domain and independently evaluated evidence as metadata; never erase gravity/light/string labels and never treat them as proof of mathematical mapping.

Distinguish narrowly speculative explanatory/ontological details from source-mathematically established or physically independently validated detailed results; don't dismiss the latter merely for being narrow.

Construct formulation-neutral relational representations and compare lawful operations/invariants by explicitly declared scopes/equivalences; include on fixed domains and relations that change through events.

When an original source uses a specified number of dimensions, distinguish mathematically necessary assumptions, representation conveniences and interpretive physical claims. Never force arbitrary physical dimension onto primitive native Causal Step.

After an independently established mathematical correspondence, use broad original phenomenon categorization only as a clue for a separate physical interpretation hypothesis requiring independent derivation/verification.

Preserve existing source failures, T4 83 state-sensitive signatures/660 triple blocks, natural provenance and research C1–C4 OPEN status; no physical-unit resemblance matching or native simulator run.
notAClaim: Retaining broad source physical labels neither declares all original authors' physics interpretations correct nor establishes an emergent Causal Step gravitational, string, light, particle, eight-dimensional or other ontology. Narrow explanations may be unsupported OR rigorous; preserve what mathematics and evidence warrant.

distinctChannels.data: Exact typed variables, relation signatures, operators, laws, quantifiers, domains, side conditions and implications as established in the original source. Preserve hard mathematical constraints regardless of author interpretation.
distinctChannels.statusRule: Source theorem/definition validity is governed by exact mathematics, not researcher's preferred interpretation.

distinctChannels.data: Author's high-level claimed physical target (e.g., gravitational behavior). Store original phrasing/source and separately record empirical or theoretical warrant, scope and alternative interpretations.
distinctChannels.statusRule: Potentially informative about physical significance, especially AFTER independent structural mapping; not automatically true simply because asserted and not a mathematical similarity test.

distinctChannels.data: Narrow mechanistic picture, causal story, ontological claim, assumed physical dimensional reading, preferred decomposition, conjecture, extrapolation or philosophical presentation.
distinctChannels.statusRule: Record accurately with evidence tier. Do not use unsupported narrative as an exclusion, dimensional imposition or canonical-map constraint. Where a fine claim is mathematically entailed or independently validated, preserve it as a qualified result.

distinctChannels.data: Separately constructed typed incidence, n-ary operations, enabling/context, legal compositions, algebraic constraints, source/target transformations, observer projections, equivalence criteria and lost structure.
distinctChannels.statusRule: A comparison at this level requires source-law preservation; mathematical correspondence precedes any claim of physical identity.

distinctChannels.data: The source's broad physical label may suggest what a newly found correspondence would be worth investigating. Keep separately the source's own physical identification, independent validation and the novel match's qualified mathematical scope.
distinctChannels.statusRule: Source broad category + clean partial isomorphism is a PHYSICAL HYPOTHESIS CLUE, not proof of native physical gravitational/light behavior; determine additional conditions before physical identification.

adjudicationOrder: Extract source-original definitions, mathematical prerequisites and exact equations with version/page provenance.
Record original broad physical categorization separately and note what, if anything, independently warrants it; do not erase it.
Record specific mechanistic interpretations separately, with whether asserted, conditional, mathematically derived, independently corroborated, contested or unknown.
Construct one or more formulation-neutral typed relational/algebraic views without importing explanatory narratives, and preserve their explicit domain of validity.
Compare structural maps/equivalences and counterexamples independently of physics names, measurements or units.

Only after mathematical compatibility is tested, consider original physical categorization as a guide for follow-up hypotheses; do not assert emergent physical identity without independently justified effective observables and laws.

handlingSpecificDimensionExample.sourcePaperEightDimensions: Retain the author's eight-dimensional model claim and source assumptions; separate whether 8 is an explicit axiom, essential theorem hypothesis, gauge/presentation convenience, special-case parameter, or derived invariant (status may be unknown).
handlingSpecificDimensionExample.mathematicalRestriction: If a source theorem REQUIRES 8 dimensions, retain that hypothesis in the mathematical source model; do not pretend proof holds for all dimensions. Study any smaller/alternative formal fragment with explicit scope and residuals instead.
handlingSpecificDimensionExample.sourceToCausalMapping: Do not assign Causal Step eight physical dimensions from the label alone, nor reject valid combinatorial maps merely because native source has no physical dimension. A faithful *full* map must still preserve whichever dimension-dependent mathematical obligations are load-bearing.
handlingSpecificDimensionExample.dimensionStatus: physical spacetime dimension is not an assumed native primitive; formal cardinality of indices/coordinates or representation rank may be exact math but not proof of physical spatial dimension.

boundedInferenceExamples: If a source model with a well-warranted gravitational broad label contains a rigorously matched relational operation, record 'structural correspondence to an operation used in a gravitational model' with the exact theorem scope, NOT 'Causal Step generates gravity'.

If a particular paper's explanation of why a term is gravitational is speculative but the mathematical identity is verified, retain the identity and the broad physical label while leaving the detailed causal story contested/open.

If a paper calls an eight-dimensional construction 'gravity,' do not force the target primitive to be eight-dimensional; require proof that the matched operation either satisfies source dimension-specific constraints or remains valid under a named restricted comparison.
